offer.a: The first {spots} sign-ups get {months} months free on the plan they picked when their access opens: Band for Band, with its 4 spots so the whole band benefits, Pro for Pro, and Pro too for those who picked Free. No credit card, no commitment: at the end, keep your plan or go back to Free.

when.a: We're opening access in waves, in sign-up order. You'll get an email with your access link when it's your turn.

pay.a: No. The plan you pick just tells us what you're interested in. You can start for free and change plans whenever you like.

phone.q: Does it work on my phone?
phone.a: Yes, on iPhone and Android, and on desktop. Ostinara installs from your browser to your home screen, like an app, without going through a store.

beginner.q: I'm a beginner, is it for me?
beginner.a: Yes. Ostinara is built for beginner to intermediate musicians, on guitar, bass, drums or keys: knowing what you're working on and seeing yourself improve is what keeps you going.

band.a: The Band plan works like a family plan: one person pays, gives away 4 spots, and the 5 of you get the whole plan, Pro included. The whole band, up to 5 musicians, gets the shared repertoire, rehearsals with date polls, synced jams, chat, demos with comments and a gig calendar with a public page. A member can also join the band with a free account.

bandStop.q: What if the person paying stops?
bandStop.a: The spots they gave away end with their billing period. The band keeps everything for 30 days, then becomes read-only: nothing is deleted, and it all reopens if they take the plan again or hand the band over to a member who has it.
